requirement.description: Invalid accs entry format causing configuration parsing failure in test_1, test_2, test_4, and test_5. The error message indicates that accs entries must be 'rwmdgGha: user1, user2, ...' but the parsing logic seems to be incorrectly handling comma-separated user lists and validation.
requirement.contract: Fix the accs entry validation logic in the `_parse_config_file` method to properly validate and parse user permissions in the format 'rwmdgGha: user1, user2, ...'. The validation should correctly handle comma-separated user identifiers and ensure that user lists are properly validated.

requirement.description: Incorrect handling of volume specification parsing in test_3. The test expects IdP functionality to work with dynamic volume creation, but the current implementation appears to not properly handle the template variables (${u}, ${g}) in volume specifications.
requirement.contract: Fix the volume specification parsing logic in the `_parse_config_file` method to properly support template variables (${u}, ${g}) in volume paths. The implementation should correctly substitute these variables when creating volumes dynamically for IdP users/groups.

requirement.description: Missing or incorrect handling of dotfile visibility in VFS listing for test. The test expects dotfiles to be properly handled according to the dotsrch flag setting, but there appears to be a discrepancy in how dotfiles are filtered in the ls method.
requirement.contract: Ensure that the VFS ls method properly applies dotsrch filtering for both real files and virtual directories when listing contents. The filtering should respect the dotsrch flag setting and hide dotfiles appropriately when dotsrch is disabled.

requirement.description: Incorrect handling of comma-separated user identifiers in permission parsing. The current implementation doesn't properly handle user identifiers that may contain periods or special characters in the comma-separated list.
requirement.contract: Update the `_read_vol_str` method to correctly parse comma-separated user identifiers that may contain periods or special characters, ensuring proper handling of user lists with complex identifiers.

requirement.description: Missing validation for invalid section headers in configuration parsing. Tests are failing due to invalid section headers, suggesting the error handling isn't catching malformed section declarations properly.
requirement.contract: Improve error handling in the `_parse_config_file` method to properly catch and report invalid section headers with appropriate error messages indicating what constitutes a valid section header format.
